label: Headline Carousel
description: A headline with one slot cycling through alternatives in a clipped vertical carousel -- 'Meet your [Engineer/Designer/Analyst]' with the bracket as a rotating outlined pill. The inline pill-carousel move. 3-5 short items; pairs beautifully with ghost-type behind it.

prefix.label: Text before the slot, e.g. 'Meet your'

pill.label: Outlined pill styling on the slot (default true)
